capabilities: Fold list items automatically on note open based on their bullet character
Configure folding separately for plain items and - [ ] checkboxes per bullet type
Convert lines between -, * and + list items via commands
Unfold everything in a note via a command
extras: Uses Obsidian's private editor.cm API, which the README warns may break in future releases; settings are localized into English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Spanish; note that Obsidian's own saved fold state can override the plugin's on reopen.
intentEvidence: Obsidian can fold a list, but the fold is a per-session gesture, not a property of the note.
motivation: The author wanted persistent fold state without polluting notes with markers like %% fold %%, callouts, or <details> blocks, using the bullet character already in the text.
problem: Obsidian's list folds are a per-session gesture that resets on reopen, so users refold the same sections every visit or add fold-marker syntax to their notes.

relations.evidence: Editors embedded by Sync Embeds are handled too.
Install BRAT and add this repository.

summary: Folds list items automatically when a note opens based on the bullet character used (-, * or +), and can convert lines between bullet types.
